matthew.18.p1.b1.text: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked,

matthew.18.p1.b2.text: Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

matthew.18.p1.b3.text: Jesus invited a little child to stand among them.

matthew.18.p2.b1.text: Truly I tell you, … unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

matthew.18.p2.b2.text: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

matthew.18.p2.b3.text: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.

matthew.18.p3.b1.text: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble,

matthew.18.p3.b2.text: it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

matthew.18.p3.b3.text: These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!

matthew.18.p4.b1.text: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away.

matthew.18.p4.b2.text: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away.

matthew.18.p4.b3.text: It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

matthew.18.p5.b1.text: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones.

matthew.18.p5.b2.text: their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.

matthew.18.p5.b3.text: If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray,

matthew.18.p5.b4.text: will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?

matthew.18.p6.b1.text: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep

matthew.18.p6.b2.text: than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.

matthew.18.p6.b3.text: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.

matthew.18.p7.b1.text: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately.

matthew.18.p7.b2.text: If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.

matthew.18.p7.b3.text: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along,

matthew.18.p7.b4.text: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church.

matthew.18.p8.b1.text: whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

matthew.18.p8.b2.text: if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.

matthew.18.p8.b3.text: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”

matthew.18.p9.b1.text: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked,

matthew.18.p9.b2.text: Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me?

matthew.18.p9.b4.text: I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!

matthew.18.p10.b1.text: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

matthew.18.p10.b2.text: As he began the settlements, a debtor was brought to him owing ten thousand talents.

matthew.18.p10.b3.text: the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.

matthew.18.p10.b4.text: Have patience with me, … and I will pay back everything.

matthew.18.p11.b1.text: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.

matthew.18.p11.b2.text: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii.

matthew.18.p11.b3.text: Pay back what you owe me!

matthew.18.p12.b1.text: Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.

matthew.18.p12.b2.text: But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison

matthew.18.p12.b3.text: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.

matthew.18.p13.b1.text: You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me. Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?

matthew.18.p13.b2.text: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that he owed.

matthew.18.p13.b3.text: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”
